credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/foxglove.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LOOMING. Gesture: the bells snap open down the spike bottom-first, as the real raceme opens (all shut, the lower bells pop, every bell flared, held, settle). Two tones: the dusky plum cloak and spire (as in the base art) and foxglove pink bells; the pink is also the lit band and the midrib of each plum leaf, so the dark cloak reads as forms. The spotted throat is a black crescent over a white lip with plum speckles, side-on, never a disc. Sport: 'Alba' (cream bells, dusky spots).
